topics.title: Duties of Security Agencies - Functions of Civic Defence Crops (Primary 2)
topics.content:
SECURITY EDUCATION
RELIGION AND NATIONAL VALUES
THIRD TERM
WEEK 7
PRIMARY 2
THEME - ELEMENTS OF SECURITY
PREVIOUS LESSON - Duties of Security Agencies - Nigerian Prison Service (Primary 2)
TOPIC - DUTIES OF SECURITY AGENCIES
LEARNING AREA
1. Identification of Security Agencies - Civic Defense Crops
2. Duties of Civic Defense Crops
PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES
By the end of the lesson, the pupils should have attained the following objectives (cognitive, affective and psychomotor) and should be able to -
identify the various security agencies(Civic Defense Crops) and their primary duties.
ENTRY BEHAVIOUR
Civic Defense Crops
INSTRUCTIONAL MATERIALS
The teacher will teach the lesson with the aid of:
Charts or pictures showing Civic Defense Crops.
METHOD OF TEACHING - Choose a suitable and appropriate methods for the lessons.
Note - Irrespective of choosing methods of teaching, always introduce an activities that will arouse pupil’s interest or lead them to the lessons.
REFERENCE MATERIALS
1. Scheme of Work
2. 9 - Years Basic Education Curriculum
3. Course Book
4. All Relevant Material
5. Online Information
CONTENT OF THE LESSON
INTRODUCTORY ACTIVITIES
DESCRIPTION OF CIVIC DEFENSE CROPS UNIFORMS
Teacher’s Activities - Listen to the pupils describing the uniforms of Civic Defense Corps.
Teacher’s remark - The security agency on the chart is called Civic Defense Corps.
DUTIES OF CIVIC DEFENSE CROPS
1. To maintain peace and order.
2. To protect and recuse people during emergency.
3. To recommend the minister on the registration of private guards companies.
4. To inspect the activities of private guards companies.
5. To provide and manage shelters for people during emergency.
6. To assist federal and state fire services in fighting fire operations.
7. To assist in distribution emergency supplies, etc.
PRESENTATION
To deliver the lesson, the teacher adopts the following steps:
1. To introduce the lesson, the teacher revises the previous lesson. Based on this, he/she asks the pupils some questions;
2. Guides the pupils to state the primary duties of Civic Defense Crops.
Pupil’s Activities - Mention the primary duties of Civic Defense Crops.
3. Organise excursion visits to the nearest Civic Defense Crops within their environment.
Pupil’s Activities - Visit the nearest Civic Defense Crops office within their environment.
CONCLUSION
- To conclude the lesson for the week, the teacher revises the entire lesson and links it to the following week’s lesson.
- Next Lesson - Duties of Security Agencies - Functions of ICPC (Primary 2)
LESSON EVALUATION
Pupils to:
1. identify and describe Civic Defense Crops.
2. state 5 duties of Civic Defense Crops.

topics.title: Qualities of Community Leaders Primary 2 (Basic 2) - Civic Education (Third Term)
topics.content:
CIVIC EDUCATION
RELIGION AND NATIONAL VALUES
THIRD TERM
WEEK 9
PRIMARY 2
THEME: OUR COMMUNITY
PREVIOUS LESSON - Humility - Meaning and Reasons why People should be Humble (Primary 2)
TOPIC: LEADER IN OUR COMMUNITY
LEARNING AREA
Qualities of Community Leaders
PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES
By the end of the lesson, the pupils should have attained the following objectives (cognitive, affective and psychomotor) and should be able to:
mention the qualities of community leaders.
INSTRUCTIONAL MATERIALS
The teacher will teach the lesson with the aid of:
Pictures of community leaders in their locality.
METHOD OF TEACHING
Choose a suitable and appropriate methods for the lessons.
Note - Irrespective of choosing methods of teaching, always introduce an activities that will arouse pupil’s interest or lead them to the lessons.
REFERENCE MATERIALS
Scheme of Work
9 - Years Basic Education Curriculum
Course Book
All Relevant Material
Online Information
CONTENT OF THE LESSON
INTRODUCTION
A community leader is a person who guides and directs the affair of the people in his/her community.
QUALITIES OF COMMUNITY LEADERS
1. Caring
2. Intelligent
3. Wise
4. Patient
5. Integrity
6. Courage
7. Honest, etc.
PRESENTATION
To deliver the lesson, the teacher adopts the following steps:
1. To introduce the lesson, the teacher revises the previous lesson. Based on this, he/she asks the pupils some questions;
2. Mentions and explains the qualities of community leaders.
Pupil’s Activities - Mention the qualities of community leaders.
CONCLUSION
- To conclude the lesson for the week, the teacher revises the entire lesson and links it to the following week’s lesson.
- Next Lesson - Road Signs - Meaning, Types and Importance of Traffic Lights and Road Signs (Primary 2)
LESSON EVALUATION
Pupils to -
mention the qualities of community leaders.
